title: Abba Cottage & Carriage House
meta_description: Find the perfect Rosemary Beach, FL vacation rental at “Abba Cottage”, a luxury 5-bed, 4.5-bath vacation rental. Ideal for 12 guests, this home house offers all the luxury amenities Rosemary Beach has to offer. Book your memorable stay now!
description_expanded: Home Highlights -Directly Next to Coquina Pool -Gulf Side of Rosemary Beach -Steps to Beach and Eastern Green -Gulf Views from Four Balconies -Carriage House -7 Adult Bikes Welcome to your luxurious beach retreat in the heart of Rosemary Beach! This stunning 6-bedroom, 5.5-bathroom getaway offers unparalleled Gulf views from four balconies and a spacious porch, ensuring you never miss a moment of the breathtaking scenery that surrounds you. Step inside and discover a newly renovated oasis where elegance meets coastal charm. With white oak floors, timber ceiling beams, and Restoration Hardware furnishings throughout, every corner exudes sophistication and comfort. The chef's kitchen is a culinary haven, boasting designer cabinets, quartz countertops, and top-of-the-line G.E. Monogram appliances, including a gas range. Gather around the dining table for 12, illuminated by a sparkling candelabra, or pull up a seat at the counter for additional space. After dinner, unwind in the living room, complete with near floor-to-ceiling windows, French doors, and a vast sectional sofa perfect for movie nights. This beachfront paradise accommodates up to 16 guests across the main house and a newly constructed carriage house. The first floor includes a guest bedroom with a king bed and private bath. Upstairs, the primary bedroom features a luxurious soaking tub and walk-in shower, with additional guest and bunk rooms sharing a bathroom. A second primary bedroom with Gulf views and a private bath completes the floor. Enjoy breathtaking views from the second-floor porch. Another highlight of this retreat is the newly constructed carriage house, featuring a full kitchen, king bedroom, and living area with a queen sleeper sofa, accommodating up to 4 guests. With the main house, this property sleeps up to 16 guests, offering an unforgettable coastal escape. Outside, soak in the stunning Gulf views from the second-floor porch or take a short stroll to the beach, just steps away from your doorstep. Plus, with seven adult bikes provided, you can explore the charming streets of Rosemary Beach with ease. For ultimate relaxation, indulge in the amenities of the Rosemary Beach community, including access to the Coquina Pool next door, where you can bask in the Florida sun from 9 am to 9 pm daily. Escape to luxury and tranquility at this exquisite beach rental, where every detail has been thoughtfully curated for your enjoyment. Book your stay today and experience the beauty of Rosemary Beach like never before. Sleeping Arrangements First Floor -King Bedroom - Private Bathroom with Shower Only Second Floor - Master Bedroom -King Bedroom - Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub - Master Bedroom -King Bedroom - Private Bathroom with Shower Only - Bunk Room - Two Twin-over-Twin Beds -Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo - King Bedroom - Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo Carriage House -King Bedroom - Private Bathroom with Shower Only Queen Sleeper Sofa In Living Area **Cottage and Carriage House are available to be booked separately except during peak/high season**
